chunks: There is no one to unveil it apart from God.
ai.seo_question: Who has the power to remove the calamity from the disbelievers according to Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Tawhid al-Asma' wa al-Sifat by affirming that while prophets and Imams may act as intermediaries (wasila), the ultimate power to remove calamity belongs solely to Allah. It refutes the polytheistic belief in independent divine agents, establishing that all relief is ultimately derived from the Divine Will. This reinforces the concept that intercession is effective only by God's permission, not by the inherent power of the intercessor.
